items.title: Labor walks tightrope as tax overhaul alarms startups and investors
items.description: Labor MPs are gearing up for a hard sell on the impact of the federal government's tax changes on some small businesses, trusts and shares, despite many reporting "positive" feedback on housing reforms.

items.title: Viral memes trying 'to catch fire on the internet' in AI Albo campaign
items.description: One startup founder who helped spread viral memes about capital gains tax reforms says the campaign was aimed at attracting attention after the budget, and not necessarily focused on accuracy.

items.title: Live: Coalition to unveil campaign to win over small businesses after budget
items.description: Shadow Treasurer Tim Wilson will today formally unveil a new opposition campaign he says will "back" the small businesses of Australia. Follow live.

items.title: More ISIS-linked women and children set to return to Australia
items.description: Six Australian women, along with their children and grandchildren, look likely to leave a camp in Syria within days.

items.title: 'Pure theft': Trump allies can seek payouts from $2.5b 'lawfare' fund
items.description: The US has set up a fund to compensate Americans deemed victims of "lawfare". Democrats say it is "pure theft of public funds" to pay the president's allies.

items.title: Life inside one of the world's most dangerous waterways
items.description: Before rising conflict pushed the Strait of Hormuz into the spotlight as a choke point vital to economies globally, tourism transformed women's lives.

items.title: Luxury apartments greenlit under affordable housing scheme
items.description: Property developers are using an affordable housing scheme to bypass normal planning requirements and win fast-tracked approval for contentious projects across Melbourne.

items.title: Putin lands in China for meeting with 'dear friend' Xi
items.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin smiles as he greets Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi at the airport in Beijing.

items.title: Why is there no vaccine for this Ebola outbreak?
items.description: The latest Ebola outbreak is caused by a strain of virus discovered nearly two decades ago, yet there is no vaccine. So what does this mean for people affected? And can vaccines be fast-tracked?

items.title: Former NT child protection staff speak out after Kumanjayi Little Baby case
items.description: In the three weeks since the alleged murder of five-year-old Kumanjayi Little Baby in Alice Springs, the NT's child protection system has come under intense scrutiny. Now, former child protection workers are speaking out about why they believe the system is broken.

items.title: Man dead, four injured in south-west Sydney shooting
items.description: A man has died and four others have been seriously injured following a Canley Heights shooting, which is believed to be organised crime-related.

items.title: Arsenal ends 22-year Premier League drought after Man City draw
items.description: Arsenal's long wait for a Premier League title comes to an end as title challengers Manchester City drop points at Bournemouth.

items.title: A mouse plague has broken out, here's what you need to know
items.description: Mice in their millions are eating grain crops, destroying food, and invading houses. Here's how it all started.

items.title: Australia is wasting $1 billion on car parks nobody uses, report finds
items.description: Australia is wasting more than $1 billion each year building off-street car parks that end up unused and unwanted, a Grattan report has found.

items.title: 'Absolute madness': How a costume rock duo are breaking the internet
items.description: French Canadian duo Angine de Poitrine are riding a wave of interest after a video of their live performance exploded in popularity, aided by a comical reaction by many on YouTube struggling to understand how their music is made.

items.title: The men offering an alternative to ‘manosphere’ influencers
items.description: "Manosphere" rhetoric is getting louder online, but can men showcasing different lifestyles and values online cut through that noise?

items.title: Quiz: Got the Wednesday blues? Let's take a trip around the world
items.description: Can you name the city in this picture? And what is the Canadian specialty food "beaver tail"?

items.title: Son of Mango founder arrested over father’s 100m cliff fall
items.description: A family spokesperson confirmed Jonathan Andic was being questioned by investigators. His father, Isak Andic, died in December 2024.

items.title: Vanuatu accuses Australia and China of 'undermining' it
items.description: Jotham Napat has confirmed Vanuatu has agreed to two pacts with both countries, but is not happy with either party.

items.title: San Diego mosque shooters met online, shared 'hatred'
items.description: Authorities have revealed the teenagers who killed three people at a San Diego mosque met online and shared a "broad hatred" toward different religions and races.

items.title: Complaint from ex-boss led to investigation into embattled mental health clinic
items.description: Tasmania's largest private mental health hospital, which was given a $2 million lifeline by the state government last year, had its corporate governance placed under review, following a formal complaint by the facility's former chief executive.

items.title: The battle for Tasmania's north has been won, but locals aren't convinced
items.description: They may not be scheduled to play their first AFL game until 2028, but the Tasmania Devils have claimed their first scalp — booting Hawthorn out of the state which has been its second home for more than two decades.

items.title: ARIA winner TISM causes $18,000 in damage to Sydney Opera House
items.description: The anarchic, ARIA-winning group has been hit with a hefty fine by the Sydney Opera House before its first national tour in more than 30 years.

items.title: UK police investigate sex abuse allegations linked to Epstein files
items.description: A British police force has said it is investigating two allegations of child sex abuse following information in documents relating to the late sex offender Jeffrey Epstein.

items.title: Bodies of two Italian divers recovered from underwater cave
items.description: Finnish divers recovered the bodies after they were located deep inside an underwater cave in the Maldives.
